messages.subject: How to keep my y-axis order?
parts:
When I transform graph from vertical to horizontal from, actual order
of y-axis (before x-axis) is changed.
How I can keep this order?

messages.subject: Re: How to keep my y-axis order?

messages.subject: Re: How to keep my y-axis order?
parts:
name, grade, section
P01,56, A
p02,68, A
p04,58, A
p03,99, B
p07,46, B
p05,44, C
p06,34, C
p08,56, C
p09,76, C

I want to plot bar chart with the same order as section in an input as
example.
I mean order in x-axis as p01,p02,p04,p03,p07,p05,p06,p08,p09. I want
to group 'names' as 'section'.

When I run as follow
>qplot(name,grade, data=test, geom="bar", fill=section)

the x-axis automatically reordered as
p01,p02,p03,p04,p05,p06,p07,p08,p09.

What option can I apply for this to keep the order of x-axis?

messages.author: fef8e67cab692da0
messages.subject: Re: How to keep my y-axis order?
parts:
>qplot(name,grade, data=test, geom="bar", fill=section)+facet_grid(~ section, scales="free")

This is working. When I changed x- and y-axis using coord_flip().
>qplot(name,grade, data=test, geom="bar", fill=section)+coord_flip()+ facet_grid(section ~ ., scales="free")
This is working, I've got three panels.
I want to plot this in one panel.
